blocks.text: Filipino chef Christopher Tamayo looked back on his experience cooking for National Basketball Association (NBA) players in the United States as he guested on the noontime show “Eat Bulaga,” saying it was one of the quests he undertook to prove his skills. Christopher—son of Steve Tamayo, the founder of Tamayo’s catering—spoke about this during his visit to the set of the noontime show on Tuesday, Oct. 27. The celebrity chef was featured during the program’s “The Age is Right” segment.
